Title: General availability: Azure API Management now has named values integration with Azure Key Vault

Body.Content:
Customers can now store, manage, and reference Azure API Management’s secrets in Azure Key Vault using the built-in named values. 

With this integration, customers can: 

  • Reference Azure Key Vault secrets shared across various services as named values. 
  • Manage and rotate named values in Azure Key Vault. 
  • Specify granular access policies for named values stored in Azure Key Vault. 

Storing and managing named values secrets in Azure Key Vault increases service security and makes it possible to reuse a secret across services.

Note: This feature is available on API version 2020-06-01 preview or later.

Learn more.
